_comment: Readout layout for the cl_showpos overlay. The exact Deadlock text format is UNVERIFIED
(specs/_measurement_protocol.md lists cl_showpos as 'medium' and says it shows position and velocity).
Edit this file after looking at your first recording; nothing in extract.py hard-codes the format.
fields[].label   : regex matched at the start of an OCR line (case-insensitive). Use line_index instead when the overlay has no labels.
fields[].names   : column names for the numbers after the label, in order.
fields[].alt_names: other accepted number counts (e.g. vel shown as one scalar instead of a vector).
fields[].full_regex: optional; overrides label+numbers. Named groups must equal column names.
decimals         : digits after the point the overlay prints (null = unknown). Known decimals lets the parser split numbers that OCR glued together.
up_axis          : which position/velocity component is vertical in the game's frame (Source engines use z).
units_per_meter  : 39.3701 = 1 u / 0.0254 m (protocol R0 must confirm this).
binarize         : used by the template backend and by line segmentation. Text is assumed brighter than its background.
label_separator  : template backend only; after this character only digits . - + are recognised (empty string disables).
